# The Reel Room Vancouver

> Private screening room and production studio rental in Mount Pleasant, Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada.

## About

The Reel Room is a private cinema facility for professional and technical use—not a public nightclub or open party venue. Book the screen room and lounge for film premieres and DCP screenings, photo and video shoots, corporate presentations and recordings, reference playback, and client reviews.

## Location

- Neighborhood: Mount Pleasant
- City: Vancouver
- Province: British Columbia (BC)
- Country: Canada
- Near downtown Vancouver

## Services

- Private screen room rental (4-hour blocks)
- DCP and digital film screening
- Production and corporate studio rental
- Reference playback and client review sessions
- Photo and video shoots in a controlled cinema environment

## Pricing overview

- Base rental: $2,300 CAD for a 4-hour block (plus on-site coordinator, cleaning fee, and applicable tax)
- Additional hours: $400 CAD per hour
- See full pricing: https://reelroom.ca/experiences

## Booking

Request a booking or tour via https://reelroom.ca/book-now or email info@reelroom.ca.
